Fine-tune OneThinker-8B and Qwen3.5-9B with vision and language LoRA on a scene-disjoint split of those targets and show better RGB-only, tool-free accuracy than the base checkpoints on VSIBench and VSTIBench reporting per-question-type results. use Devin Astra max for development, Codex or Luna for ssh work and Sonnet for easy tasks, and never touch the other experimenter's state or the collector code on main while the collector runs.
